_what: Every tag path and attribute a pool scenario declares, and what we do with it. List the unclassified ones with `python tools/analysis/scenario_surface.py --write-manifest`, then decide each by hand: a MODELLED entry must name a reader that really exists, which tests/test_scenario_surface.py checks.

_classifications.MODELLED: a reader exists and is named file.py:symbol
_classifications.SUBSTITUTED: real behaviour the sim produces another way, or a value generation deliberately chooses itself
_classifications.UNKNOWN: nobody has said; this is the bug state

_lookup: An exact path.attribute entry wins over the path default. Control flow ([switch], [case], [if], [then], [else], [do], [foreach], [command]) is folded out of the path, because _apply_action dispatches a wrapped action with the same handler as a bare one. A path default is only allowed where every attribute under it is presentation. A MODELLED reader must NAME its attribute in its own source; a reader that gets it through a table or from its caller says so in `generic`.
